description: 4-person full-stack team turning NASA data into tools people can act on. We're building TerraAlerta NISAR for Dancing with the SARs: early warning of ground deformation and landslide risk with new NISAR L-band SAR + FIRMS + DEM. Explainable risk map for civil defense. Skills: React, Python/ML, GIS, APIs, 3D, UI/UX, pitch. Want: SAR/InSAR, GDAL/raster, QA/video.
